title: Applying Defense-in-Depth to Agentic Pipelines: Does Layering Safety Interventions Produce Compounding Benefits?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Whether safety interventions compound or interfere is a fundamental question for deployment strategy. The result directly tells practitioners whether to layer defenses or carefully select. High practical value for the entire AI safety engineering community.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Testing 7 interventions individually plus 21 pairwise combinations on a task suite requires implementing 7 different safety interventions and running 28 experimental conditions. This is a large-scale experiment requiring substantial engineering and compute time.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 28 experimental conditions on a task suite is far too large for 30 hours. Even with 3 interventions (3 individual + 3 pairs = 6 conditions), the time to implement each intervention and run evaluations would be very tight.
